title: SCA Minhag of the Week 167: "Customs of the 9th of Ab"

chapters.title: Synagogue customs and Kaddish
chapters.about: Sitting on the floor and Kaddish Titkabal

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the customs of the community regarding Tisha BeAb, focusing on prayer variations and practices for breaking the fast. He references various books and Hachamim to explain the history and application of these traditions in Halab and other locations.
questions: Do we recite Kaddish Titkabal on the night of Tisha BeAb?
Why do we replace Az Yashir with Ha'azinu on Tisha BeAb morning?
Is Birkat Kohanim recited on Tisha BeAb?
Is there a Haftarah in Mincha on Tisha BeAb?
Is it permitted to eat meat immediately after the fast of Tisha BeAb?
